name: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park
description: Bwindi Impenetrable National Park is a dense stretch of lowland and mountain forest in south-western Uganda, right beside the Congo border. Reachable only on foot, it shelters roughly 400 mountain gorillas, about half the world's total, along with chimpanzees, colobus monkeys, hornbills and hundreds of butterfly species. Trekking here means meeting gorilla families in thick, fern-draped jungle.
